mary	Upon arrival met with the excavation crew at 2604 Clarkdale Ln. Austin TX 78757 to perform additional camera diagnostics and establish the excavation location.

Camera inspections were performed through the kitchen sink vent as well as the laundry vent and laundry drain line. PVC drainage piping was observed throughout the accessible portions of the system with the exception of the kitchen drain line.

While inspecting the kitchen drain the camera was advanced to approximately one foot below slab level where a significant separation break or obstruction was encountered. The camera could not be advanced beyond this location preventing further visual confirmation of the downstream piping.

Based on the camera location and site conditions we determined that accessing the affected area from the front of the home is the most practical approach. This requires approximately one additional foot of excavation compared with accessing the piping through the rear patio. Rear access would require disturbing the concrete surrounding the pool area which would be significantly more difficult to restore and match properly.

PVC piping was observed penetrating the slab and appears to continue into or through a structural beam beneath the foundation. The suspected failure is located in this general area.

The excavation crew will proceed with carefully excavating and gaining access to the affected piping over approximately the next two days. Once the piping is fully exposed we will evaluate the exact condition and configuration of the drainage system confirm the cause and extent of the failure and develop the appropriate repair plan based on the conditions found.
